payload.acceptance_criteria:
When setup installs system packages with apt, dnf or pacman, it shall install the gpg and xz packages of that package manager (apt: gnupg, xz-utils; dnf: gnupg2, xz; pacman: gnupg, xz) before the Node.js and WezTerm steps.
When the apt package git-delta is not available, setup shall install delta from its release binary.
When an unattended step fails, setup shall print the step's stderr and name its last stderr lines in the failure line.
payload.description:
## Context
The linux-container job of term-3osnol (run 44600228645, 2026-11-19) showed that setup fails on a bare ubuntu:24.04 and debian:12. The Node.js step unpacks with tar -xJf and the image has no xz ("tar (child): xz: Cannot exec"). The WezTerm apt key step pipes into sudo gpg and the image has no gnupg ("sudo: gpg: command not found"). Debian 12 has no git-delta package. The stderr of a failed step was printed, but above the step and not in its failure line, because Python stdout is block-buffered when piped and the failure line keeps only the last stderr line. Orchestrator decision 2026-11-19 19:50 UTC (dev-j6oqo).

## Confirmation Plan
Run the unit tests for the changed code, then the linux-container job of e2e-install on GitHub by workflow_dispatch on branch term-3osnol.
payload.title: Install gpg and xz on bare Linux, delta fallback, step stderr in the failure line
